now.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
now.text: Wenwu tells Katy that some years ago an American terrorist stole the legend of his Ten Rings and, not knowing his real name, invented the Mandarin for his figurehead. He never names Killian, and they never meet.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The terrorist who stole Wenwu's Ten Rings legend for his fake Mandarin.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The real Ten Rings leader, whose legend Killian stole for the Mandarin.

changes.evidence: In Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings, Wenwu only tells a story about the American terrorist who borrowed his legend to invent the Mandarin. By then Killian is long dead, and the stage text itself says Wenwu never names him and they never meet. The two never deal with each other on screen, and nothing implies they know each other. Wenwu's actual dealings are with Trevor Slattery, whom the Ten Rings imprisoned for the impersonation. This is knowing ABOUT someone, a story told about a dead man, and the hoax has no huge consequence for Wenwu.
